name: Inoue Genzaburou
source:
Shinsengumi Affiliation: Captain of the Sixth Unit
Dojo: Tennen Rishin-Ryuu (License of Mastery / Menkyo Kaiden)
Blade’s Name: Shirakawa no Sumi Kanezune / Made by Kanezune, who lives in Shirakawa

Born on April 4th, 1829, at one of Hachiouji’s Guards’ houses, located in modern Hino, Tokyo.

A licensed master of the Tennen Rishin-Ryuu style, Inoue is a straightforward yet laid-back individual, giving her notoriety within the ranks of the Shinsengumi.

Inoue is among the rare Shinsengumi members unafraid to voice her opinions to Kondou and Toshizou, her long-time friends.

She tends to observe from a distance, intervening only when absolutely needed.

"I've always wondered what kind of couple Isarin & Hijirin would make if one of them were a man..."
